items.claim: "Add pref" with nothing selected puts a loose leaf at a root that holds pages
items.note: I made the strict call: "Add pref" is disabled wherever the new pref would sit under that root on no page, which also covers a selected loose root leaf. The call is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`. `AssetEditor.panel.test.tsx` assumed "Add pref" was enabled with nothing selected, so it now selects a page first.
